_readme: English names for PDOK services and layers. Hand maintained.
This file is deliberately NOT part of resources/layers-pdok.json, which is
regenerated wholesale by scripts/generate-pdok-layers-config.sh and would
Lookup keys are normalized: lowercased, and '_' and runs of whitespace
folded to a single space. So one entry covers 'Waterdeel vlak',
Resolution order for a layer title:
1. 'layer_titles' exact match on the normalized Dutch title
3. no translation: the Dutch original is shown on its own
A trailing official abbreviation such as '(BTD)' is kept untranslated.
Translations are only added where the English term is reasonably settled.
Leaving a term out is safe and preferred over inventing a name: the Dutch
